subject: SDG Weekly Compass - Week of 2026-11-24
overview_zh: COP31暴露气候治理的执行缺口：融资文本缩水，终稿仍回避关键承诺。

items.title_en: COP31 cover draft removes fossil-fuel and adaptation-finance specifics
items.summary_zh: COP31第三版主席国封面决议草案删除了对转向化石燃料的直接表述，也没有就三倍适应融资、1200亿美元目标或IPCC下一轮报告给出明确时间表，说明主席国试图用程序性语言维持谈判框架，却回避了最具约束力的政治分歧。

terms.explanation_zh: 用于减缓、适应、损失与损害等气候行动的公共或私人资金安排。

items.core_argument_zh: COP31第三版主席国封面决议草案删除了对转向化石燃料的直接表述，也没有就三倍适应融资、1200亿美元目标或IPCC下一轮报告给出明确时间表，说明主席国试图用程序性语言维持谈判框架，却回避了最具约束力的政治分歧。
items.core_argument_en: COP31’s third presidency draft drops direct fossil-fuel language and gives no clear timetable for tripling adaptation finance, a $120bn adaptation target, or the next IPCC report, showing an attempt to preserve the process while sidestepping the most binding political disputes.
items.why_now_zh: 这份草案出现在闭幕前夕，直接暴露主席国在最后一轮收束文本时能否把争议转成可接受的最低共识。它也承接前几轮文本中反复收缩的融资与化石燃料条款。
items.why_now_en: Released on the eve of closure, the draft tests whether the presidency can convert dispute into an acceptable minimum consensus. It also follows earlier drafts that steadily stripped out finance and fossil-fuel provisions.
items.agenda_position_zh: 这是COP31封面决议谈判的正式文本之一，直接嵌入大会最终政治结果的形成过程。
items.agenda_position_en: This is one of the formal COP31 cover-decision texts and sits directly inside the process that shapes the summit’s final political outcome.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这份草案出现在闭幕前夕，直接暴露主席国在最后一轮收束文本时能否把争议转成可接受的最低共识。它也承接前几轮文本中反复收缩的融资与化石燃料条款。

items.title_en: Climate-finance work programme narrows to process language at COP31
items.summary_zh: COP31气候融资工作方案文本从11页压缩为2页，原本关于负担分担、贡献方扩大与三倍适应融资的实质内容被删除，显示各方仍在争夺融资责任应由谁承担、谈判程序应持续多久以及成果应是什么类型。

terms.explanation_zh: 用于减缓、适应、损失与损害等气候行动的公共或私人资金安排。

items.core_argument_zh: COP31气候融资工作方案文本从11页压缩为2页，原本关于负担分担、贡献方扩大与三倍适应融资的实质内容被删除，显示各方仍在争夺融资责任应由谁承担、谈判程序应持续多久以及成果应是什么类型。
items.core_argument_en: At COP31, the climate-finance work programme was cut from 11 pages to 2, with burden-sharing, contributor-base expansion and tripling-adaptation-finance provisions removed, showing that parties are still contesting who should carry finance responsibility, how long the process should run, and what kind of outcome it should deliver.
items.why_now_zh: 这份文本出现在部长级收束前，说明融资争议已从原则分歧转为文本层面的删减与保留。它也解释了为何后续封面决议会继续回避融资实质。
items.why_now_en: The text emerged during the ministerial endgame, showing that the finance dispute had shifted from principle to line-by-line subtraction. It also helps explain why later cover-decision drafts continued to avoid finance substance.

items.title_en: Nature paper calls for mandatory water-footprint transparency in mining
items.summary_zh: 该研究主张将矿业用水、排放和污染披露设为强制要求，并把透明度作为关键矿产资本配置的前提，以此纠正长期依赖自愿披露和碎片化监管所造成的社区信息盲区与风险外部化。
items.core_argument_zh: 该研究主张将矿业用水、排放和污染披露设为强制要求，并把透明度作为关键矿产资本配置的前提，以此纠正长期依赖自愿披露和碎片化监管所造成的社区信息盲区与风险外部化。
items.core_argument_en: The paper argues that mining firms’ withdrawals, discharges and contamination should be subject to mandatory disclosure, with transparency treated as a condition for capital allocation to critical-mineral supply chains, correcting the information gaps and externalized risks produced by voluntary reporting and fragmented regulation.
items.why_now_zh: 关键矿产供应链扩张正在加快，而资源开发周边社区对水风险的可见度仍然有限，因此该文把透明度问题从企业披露上升为融资条件。
items.why_now_en: As critical-mineral supply chains expand, communities near extraction sites still have limited visibility over water risks, so the paper elevates transparency from a reporting issue to a financing condition.
items.agenda_position_zh: 该文主要对应采矿监管、供应链尽职调查和可持续金融框架；没有正式谈判提交，但它直接影响关键矿产与水治理的政策设计。
items.agenda_position_en: The paper speaks to mining regulation, supply-chain due diligence and sustainable-finance frameworks; no formal negotiating submission is documented, but it directly bears on policy design for critical minerals and water governance.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 关键矿产供应链扩张正在加快，而资源开发周边社区对水风险的可见度仍然有限，因此该文把透明度问题从企业披露上升为融资条件。
items.why_it_matters_en: As critical-mineral supply chains expand, communities near extraction sites still have limited visibility over water risks, so the paper elevates transparency from a reporting issue to a financing condition.

items.title_en: Water-governance resilience depends on coordination and accountability
items.summary_zh: 作者通过五个国际案例指出，水治理中的韧性（resilience）不应被当作静态终点，而应作为治理设计与运行原则，依赖适应性、协调、学习和问责来处理跨部门、跨尺度的复杂不确定性。
items.core_argument_zh: 作者通过五个国际案例指出，水治理中的韧性（resilience）不应被当作静态终点，而应作为治理设计与运行原则，依赖适应性、协调、学习和问责来处理跨部门、跨尺度的复杂不确定性。
items.core_argument_en: Drawing on five international cases, the authors argue that resilience in water governance should not be treated as a static end state but as a governing principle, relying on adaptability, coordination, learning and accountability to manage cross-sector and cross-scale uncertainty.
items.why_now_zh: 随着旱涝风险和基础设施脆弱性上升，单纯强调工程能力已不足以解释水系统为何失灵或如何修复。该研究为当前围绕适应与执行的政策争论提供了更制度化的语言。
items.why_now_en: As drought and flood risks rise and infrastructure vulnerability deepens, engineering capacity alone no longer explains why water systems fail or how they recover. The study offers a more institutional language for current debates over adaptation and implementation.
items.agenda_position_zh: 该文对应水治理改革与适应政策设计，并未嵌入某一正式国际谈判文本，但对各类流域和城市水管理制度具有直接参考价值。
items.agenda_position_en: The paper speaks to water-governance reform and adaptation policy design; it is not embedded in a formal international negotiation text, but it is directly relevant to basin and urban water-management institutions.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 随着旱涝风险和基础设施脆弱性上升，单纯强调工程能力已不足以解释水系统为何失灵或如何修复。该研究为当前围绕适应与执行的政策争论提供了更制度化的语言。
items.why_it_matters_en: As drought and flood risks rise and infrastructure vulnerability deepens, engineering capacity alone no longer explains why water systems fail or how they recover. The study offers a more institutional language for current debates over adaptation and implementation.

readings.title: Who Controls Multilateral Development Finance?
readings.note_zh: 这篇文章衡量28家多边开发银行（MDB）的治理投票权分布，并据此区分债权人主导、核心借款人主导与互助导向三类制度。它说明，谁掌握治理权，谁就更可能影响发展融资的流向与条件。
readings.note_en: The article measures voting-power distributions across 28 multilateral development banks and distinguishes creditor-led, core borrower-led, and mutual aid-oriented governance types. It shows that who holds governance power is closely tied to who can shape the direction and terms of development finance.
readings.journal: Global Governance: A Review of Multilateralism and International Organizations
readings.methodology_zh: 作者使用Penrose-Banzhaf与Shapley-Shubik权力指数，并结合成员国在MDB董事会中的相对投票权，对28家MDB的治理结构进行比较测算。
readings.method_en: The author uses Penrose-Banzhaf and Shapley-Shubik power indices, together with members’ relative voting power on MDB boards, to compare governance structures across 28 MDBs.
readings.today_connection_zh: 可与本期COP31气候融资僵局一起阅读，因为谈判中反复出现的责任分担、资金来源与融资条件之争，本质上都指向“谁来控制资金、谁来承担成本”。
readings.today_connection_en: Read alongside this issue’s COP31 finance deadlock, because the recurring disputes over burden sharing, funding sources, and financing conditions all come back to who controls the money and who bears the costs.

research_directions.question_zh: MDB投票权如何影响气候融资分配？
research_directions.question_en: How does MDB voting power affect the distribution of climate finance?

research_directions.question_zh: 借款国如何在发展融资治理中争取更大话语权？
research_directions.question_en: How do borrower countries gain greater influence in development finance governance?

readings.abstract_en: Multilateral development banks ( MDB s) are a growing source of development finance, with nearly two trillion dollars in assets. They have developed a wide array of governance structures, with implications for the distribution of members’ control over those assets. This paper measures that power distribution in 28 MDB s using Penrose-Banzhaf and Shapley-Shubik power indices and members’ relative voting power on MDB governance boards. It uses these calculations to create a typology of MDB governance structures: creditor-led MDB s distribute power among non-borrowers, core borrower-led MDB s distribute power among a few central borrowers, and mutual aid-oriented MDB s distribute power among a wide group of borrowers. Finally, it explores the impact of the creation of two new MDB s, the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank and the New Development Bank, and finds that while they do not dramatically alter the global landscape they do allow significantly greater access to capital for some borrowers.

readings.title: Legitimacy by Design: Institutional Representation and Public Support for Global Governance
readings.authors: Philipp Bien, Thomas Malang, Matthias Mader
readings.note_zh: 这篇研究表明，把国会议员纳入国际组织决策，能显著提升公众对全球治理机构的合法性感知。尤其在政治立场更分化、对国际合作更怀疑的人群中，代表性设计更能修复合法性压力，因此可被视为一种可扩展的制度回应。
readings.note_en: The study finds that including parliamentarians in international-organization decision-making significantly raises perceived legitimacy. The effect is especially strong among politically diverse or skeptical publics, making representational design a scalable institutional response to legitimacy pressure in global governance.
readings.methodology_zh: 作者使用预注册联合实验，让受访者评估若干属性不同的虚拟国际组织决策，其中包括是否存在、以及何种类型的议员参与。通过比较这些情境，作者识别代表性安排对合法性感知的影响。
readings.method_en: The authors use a pre-registered conjoint experiment in which respondents evaluate hypothetical IO decisions varying across several attributes, including the presence and type of parliamentary involvement. Comparing these scenarios allows them to estimate how representational design affects legitimacy perceptions.
readings.today_connection_zh: 可与COP31破裂后的气候治理改革讨论一起读：当谈判机制难以形成共识时，这篇文章提醒我们，制度设计本身就是合法性的一部分，而不是事后装饰。
readings.today_connection_en: Read alongside the post-COP31 debate on climate-governance reform: when negotiation machinery fails to produce consensus, this paper suggests legitimacy is built into institutional design itself, not added afterward.

research_directions.question_zh: 更广泛的代表性是否能缓解全球治理中的合法性危机？
research_directions.question_en: Does broader representation ease legitimacy crises in global governance?

research_directions.question_zh: 哪些制度参与形式最能提升公众支持？
research_directions.question_en: Which forms of institutional participation most increase public support?

readings.abstract_en: International Organizations (IOs) increasingly face legitimacy challenges. One institutional response has been the creation of International Parliamentary Institutions (IPIs), which include national parliamentarians in IO decision-making. We argue that by broadening political representation beyond national executives from the political majority, IPIs can strengthen legitimacy, especially among politically diverse or skeptical publics. We test this claim with a pre-registered conjoint experiment. Respondents evaluated hypothetical IO decisions that varied in several attributes, including the presence and type of parliamentary involvement. We find that parliamentary participation significantly increases perceived legitimacy. The effect is substantial and consistent across different IOs, policy issues, and population subgroups, including citizens with populist attitudes, who are often critical of international cooperation. Legitimacy increases further when parliamentary actors support the IO decision. Our findings suggest that IPIs can enhance the sociological legitimacy of IOs by improving perceptions of representation and accountability. While not a panacea, IPIs offer a scalable, publicly resonant response to legitimacy concerns in global governance.

overview_en: COP31 exposed an execution gap in climate governance: the finance text shrank, and the final draft still avoided key commitments.
weekly_thread_zh: 本期共同问题不是承诺是否存在，而是它们能否进入可执行、可追踪的制度文本。COP31的融资与化石燃料争议、以及水治理研究对问责与协调的强调，都指向同一检验标准。
weekly_thread_en: This week’s shared question is not whether commitments exist, but whether they can be translated into enforceable, trackable institutional text. COP31’s finance and fossil-fuel disputes, together with water-governance research on accountability and coordination, point to the same test.

research_signals.why_now_zh: 关键矿产供应链扩张正在加快，而资源开发周边社区对水风险的可见度仍然有限，因此该文把透明度问题从企业披露上升为融资条件。
research_signals.why_now_en: As critical-mineral supply chains expand, communities near extraction sites still have limited visibility over water risks, so the paper elevates transparency from a reporting issue to a financing condition.
research_signals.agenda_position_zh: 该文主要对应采矿监管、供应链尽职调查和可持续金融框架；没有正式谈判提交，但它直接影响关键矿产与水治理的政策设计。
research_signals.agenda_position_en: The paper speaks to mining regulation, supply-chain due diligence and sustainable-finance frameworks; no formal negotiating submission is documented, but it directly bears on policy design for critical minerals and water governance.
research_signals.why_it_matters_zh: 关键矿产供应链扩张正在加快，而资源开发周边社区对水风险的可见度仍然有限，因此该文把透明度问题从企业披露上升为融资条件。
research_signals.why_it_matters_en: As critical-mineral supply chains expand, communities near extraction sites still have limited visibility over water risks, so the paper elevates transparency from a reporting issue to a financing condition.
research_signals.title_original: Accounting for the mining industry’s global water footprint

research_signals.title_en: Water-governance resilience depends on coordination and accountability
research_signals.summary_zh: 作者通过五个国际案例指出，水治理中的韧性（resilience）不应被当作静态终点，而应作为治理设计与运行原则，依赖适应性、协调、学习和问责来处理跨部门、跨尺度的复杂不确定性。
research_signals.core_argument_zh: 作者通过五个国际案例指出，水治理中的韧性（resilience）不应被当作静态终点，而应作为治理设计与运行原则，依赖适应性、协调、学习和问责来处理跨部门、跨尺度的复杂不确定性。
research_signals.core_argument_en: Drawing on five international cases, the authors argue that resilience in water governance should not be treated as a static end state but as a governing principle, relying on adaptability, coordination, learning and accountability to manage cross-sector and cross-scale uncertainty.
research_signals.why_now_zh: 随着旱涝风险和基础设施脆弱性上升，单纯强调工程能力已不足以解释水系统为何失灵或如何修复。该研究为当前围绕适应与执行的政策争论提供了更制度化的语言。
research_signals.why_now_en: As drought and flood risks rise and infrastructure vulnerability deepens, engineering capacity alone no longer explains why water systems fail or how they recover. The study offers a more institutional language for current debates over adaptation and implementation.
research_signals.agenda_position_zh: 该文对应水治理改革与适应政策设计，并未嵌入某一正式国际谈判文本，但对各类流域和城市水管理制度具有直接参考价值。
research_signals.agenda_position_en: The paper speaks to water-governance reform and adaptation policy design; it is not embedded in a formal international negotiation text, but it is directly relevant to basin and urban water-management institutions.
research_signals.why_it_matters_zh: 随着旱涝风险和基础设施脆弱性上升，单纯强调工程能力已不足以解释水系统为何失灵或如何修复。该研究为当前围绕适应与执行的政策争论提供了更制度化的语言。
research_signals.why_it_matters_en: As drought and flood risks rise and infrastructure vulnerability deepens, engineering capacity alone no longer explains why water systems fail or how they recover. The study offers a more institutional language for current debates over adaptation and implementation.
research_signals.title_original: Resilience as a governing principle in water governance

classic_readings.title: Who Controls Multilateral Development Finance?
classic_readings.note_zh: 这篇文章衡量28家多边开发银行（MDB）的治理投票权分布，并据此区分债权人主导、核心借款人主导与互助导向三类制度。它说明，谁掌握治理权，谁就更可能影响发展融资的流向与条件。
classic_readings.note_en: The article measures voting-power distributions across 28 multilateral development banks and distinguishes creditor-led, core borrower-led, and mutual aid-oriented governance types. It shows that who holds governance power is closely tied to who can shape the direction and terms of development finance.
classic_readings.journal: Global Governance: A Review of Multilateralism and International Organizations
classic_readings.methodology_zh: 作者使用Penrose-Banzhaf与Shapley-Shubik权力指数，并结合成员国在MDB董事会中的相对投票权，对28家MDB的治理结构进行比较测算。
classic_readings.method_en: The author uses Penrose-Banzhaf and Shapley-Shubik power indices, together with members’ relative voting power on MDB boards, to compare governance structures across 28 MDBs.
classic_readings.today_connection_zh: 可与本期COP31气候融资僵局一起阅读，因为谈判中反复出现的责任分担、资金来源与融资条件之争，本质上都指向“谁来控制资金、谁来承担成本”。
classic_readings.today_connection_en: Read alongside this issue’s COP31 finance deadlock, because the recurring disputes over burden sharing, funding sources, and financing conditions all come back to who controls the money and who bears the costs.

research_directions.question_zh: MDB投票权如何影响气候融资分配？
research_directions.question_en: How does MDB voting power affect the distribution of climate finance?

research_directions.question_zh: 借款国如何在发展融资治理中争取更大话语权？
research_directions.question_en: How do borrower countries gain greater influence in development finance governance?

classic_readings.abstract_en: Multilateral development banks ( MDB s) are a growing source of development finance, with nearly two trillion dollars in assets. They have developed a wide array of governance structures, with implications for the distribution of members’ control over those assets. This paper measures that power distribution in 28 MDB s using Penrose-Banzhaf and Shapley-Shubik power indices and members’ relative voting power on MDB governance boards. It uses these calculations to create a typology of MDB governance structures: creditor-led MDB s distribute power among non-borrowers, core borrower-led MDB s distribute power among a few central borrowers, and mutual aid-oriented MDB s distribute power among a wide group of borrowers. Finally, it explores the impact of the creation of two new MDB s, the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank and the New Development Bank, and finds that while they do not dramatically alter the global landscape they do allow significantly greater access to capital for some borrowers.

classic_readings.title: Legitimacy by Design: Institutional Representation and Public Support for Global Governance
classic_readings.authors: Philipp Bien, Thomas Malang, Matthias Mader
classic_readings.note_zh: 这篇研究表明，把国会议员纳入国际组织决策，能显著提升公众对全球治理机构的合法性感知。尤其在政治立场更分化、对国际合作更怀疑的人群中，代表性设计更能修复合法性压力，因此可被视为一种可扩展的制度回应。
classic_readings.note_en: The study finds that including parliamentarians in international-organization decision-making significantly raises perceived legitimacy. The effect is especially strong among politically diverse or skeptical publics, making representational design a scalable institutional response to legitimacy pressure in global governance.
classic_readings.methodology_zh: 作者使用预注册联合实验，让受访者评估若干属性不同的虚拟国际组织决策，其中包括是否存在、以及何种类型的议员参与。通过比较这些情境，作者识别代表性安排对合法性感知的影响。
classic_readings.method_en: The authors use a pre-registered conjoint experiment in which respondents evaluate hypothetical IO decisions varying across several attributes, including the presence and type of parliamentary involvement. Comparing these scenarios allows them to estimate how representational design affects legitimacy perceptions.
classic_readings.today_connection_zh: 可与COP31破裂后的气候治理改革讨论一起读：当谈判机制难以形成共识时，这篇文章提醒我们，制度设计本身就是合法性的一部分，而不是事后装饰。
classic_readings.today_connection_en: Read alongside the post-COP31 debate on climate-governance reform: when negotiation machinery fails to produce consensus, this paper suggests legitimacy is built into institutional design itself, not added afterward.

research_directions.question_zh: 更广泛的代表性是否能缓解全球治理中的合法性危机？
research_directions.question_en: Does broader representation ease legitimacy crises in global governance?

research_directions.question_zh: 哪些制度参与形式最能提升公众支持？
research_directions.question_en: Which forms of institutional participation most increase public support?

classic_readings.abstract_en: International Organizations (IOs) increasingly face legitimacy challenges. One institutional response has been the creation of International Parliamentary Institutions (IPIs), which include national parliamentarians in IO decision-making. We argue that by broadening political representation beyond national executives from the political majority, IPIs can strengthen legitimacy, especially among politically diverse or skeptical publics. We test this claim with a pre-registered conjoint experiment. Respondents evaluated hypothetical IO decisions that varied in several attributes, including the presence and type of parliamentary involvement. We find that parliamentary participation significantly increases perceived legitimacy. The effect is substantial and consistent across different IOs, policy issues, and population subgroups, including citizens with populist attitudes, who are often critical of international cooperation. Legitimacy increases further when parliamentary actors support the IO decision. Our findings suggest that IPIs can enhance the sociological legitimacy of IOs by improving perceptions of representation and accountability. While not a panacea, IPIs offer a scalable, publicly resonant response to legitimacy concerns in global governance.

issue_title_en: COP31 deadlock, finance gaps and implementation tests
issue_title_zh: COP31僵局、融资缺口与执行考验

title_support.angle_en: This article supports the COP31 deadlock and implementation test by showing the presidency’s pact failed over fossil-fuel language and climate-finance references, while only limited procedural items moved forward.
This article supports the finance-gap part of the title by describing how the climate-finance work programme was reduced to process language, with tripling-adaptation-finance substance removed.

This article supports the implementation-test framing because the final draft still lacked specificity on adaptation finance, fossil-fuel transition wording and IPCC timing, showing unresolved delivery mechanics.

This paper supports the broader implementation lens by arguing that critical-mineral supply chains need mandatory water-footprint transparency, turning resource governance into a concrete execution problem.

This paper supports the implementation and state-capacity strand by reframing resilience in water governance as adaptability, coordination, learning and accountability rather than a static technical endpoint.
